_about: Which OpenClaw model each provider on the AI switch (Settings › APIs) becomes on the Mini, and the key OpenClaw needs for it (SC-874). scripts/openclaw_switch_sync.mjs reads the switch's order and writes these into ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json. A provider not listed here (Kimi, any added service) is reported on the bus, never quietly dropped. Read through lib/openclawSwitchSync.js; the installer's own default list is lib/openclawModels.json.

unsupported.kimi: OpenClaw needs its separate Moonshot plugin for Kimi, and it is not installed on the Mini
